subject.title: fix(cli-runner): add host-only CLI auth epoch mode

question: May OpenClaw treat a hash of the Claude CLI OAuth refresh token as the stable account identity that permits omitting the selected auth-profile credential from session invalidation?
rationale: The repository and upstream credential shape do not currently establish refresh tokens as stable account identifiers, while the answer controls whether session context may be reused across an auth-profile boundary.

options.title: Require proven stable identity
options.body: Keep profile-bound invalidation unless current main can derive an explicitly stable Claude account identity, preserving fail-closed behavior for partial or identity-less reads.

options.title: Accept refresh-token identity
options.body: Adopt the refresh-token hash as the identity contract only with explicit ownership approval plus partial-read, rotation, account-switch, and upgrade compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Require proven stable identity
recommendation.body: Keep profile-bound invalidation unless current main can derive an explicitly stable Claude account identity, preserving fail-closed behavior for partial or identity-less reads.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent merged host-managed Claude CLI hardening work makes this the strongest available owner for the subprocess credential-ownership decision.
